title: fritillaria lusitanica subsp. hispanica
intro: Fritillaria lusitanica subsp. hispanica, commonly known as the Spanish snake's head or hispanic fritillary, is a plant species within the lily family (Liliaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its traditional use in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Fritillaria lusitanica subsp. hispanica include expectorant and mucolytic effects, which help to loosen and clear mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, specifically lycorine and galantamine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
